crossRefs.note: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will…
Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

translations.web: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
translations.bsb: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
translations.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
translations.asv: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.
